The Sun emits 4 10 J of energy per second. Of this, approximately 1400 J is incident on one square meter of the top of the atmosphere. The atmosphere above a forest reflects 400 J of this energy and the rest reaches the forest. The amount of energy absorbed by the forest is 280 J. 

What is the albedo of the forest?

  1. 0.20
  2. 0.28
  3. 0.70
  4. 0.72
